cookies.skill: Blooming Dancheong Cookie was baked from gat-kimchi, made by grinding plum blossoms that bloomed in the snow and seasoning them over mustard leaves. Born from ingredients that overcame biting winds and solitude, this Cookie came to possess a spirit both resilient and noble. To create a land where Cookies could thrive, Blooming Dancheong Cookie gathered the energy of the Five Colors, swept away the heavy clouds, and planted a colossal plum World Tree on Mount Kimchi, the peak closest to the sky, linking heaven and earth as one. Warm sunlight and the gentle fragrance of plum blossoms soon began to fill the barren land. A world that had once been silent slowly became alive with the laughter of Cookies, and Blooming Dancheong Cookie, accompanied by the Plum Blossom Dragons, continued to watch over them. Though the tale now lives on only as a legend, a lone shrine is said to still be standing at the summit of Mount Kimchi, where Blooming Dancheong Cookie is worshipped as a mountain spirit.
